ara: سَلَامٌ عَلَى الْإِخْوَانِ فِي كُلِّ مَوْضِعٍ
سَلَامًا يَعُمُّ الْكُلَّ فِي كُلِّ مَجْمَعِ
فَهَذَا أَسَاسُ الْخَيْرِ إِنْ كُنْتَ عَاقِلًا
وَكُلُّ الَّذِي قَدْ نَالَ عِلْمًا وَسُؤْدُدًا
وَأَعْنِي بِهِ الشَّيْخَ الَّذِي فَاضَ نُورُهُ
وَلَا تَغْفُلَنْ فِي حَالَةِ الضَّيْقِ وَالْوُسْعِ
هُوَ الْمَوْرِدُ الْأَصْفَى فَهَلْ أَنْتَ سَامِعِ
وَحُسْنِ صِفَاتٍ ثُمَّ فِي النُّورِ اللَّامِعِ
عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ عَدَّ وَتْرٍ مَعَ الشَّفْعِ
دَعَا لِطَرِيقِ اللَّهِ فِي كُلِّ مَجْمَعِ
en: salāmun ʿala l-ikhwāni fī kulli mawḍiʿi
salāman yaʿummu l-kulla fī kulli majmaʿi
wa-innī urīdu n-nuṣḥa li-l-kulli rājiyan
bulūgha l-munā wa-l-ʿizzi wa-l-fatḥi wa-l-wusʿi
fa-awwalu nuṣḥī li-lladhī ḥarrara t-taqwā
muṣāḥabatu l-akhyāri fi l-jalbi wa-d-dafʿi
fa-hādhā asāsu l-khayri in kunta ʿāqilan
fa-ʿawwil ʿalayhi maʿ murāʿātin li-sh-sharʿi
wa-kullu lladhī qad nāla ʿilman wa-suʾdudan
fa-mā nālahū illā bi-ṣuḥbati khāshiʿi
wa-aʿnī bihi sh-shaykha lladhī fāḍa nūruhū
wa-jāʾa bi-asrārin wa-khayrin mutābiʿi
fa-in shiʾta anwāran wa-fatḥa baṣīratin
fa-qallidhu taʿẓīman wa-ʿuj ʿan munāziʿi
wa-wāẓib ʿala dh-dhikri l-mulaqqani bi-l-idhni
wa-lā taghfulan fī ḥālati ḍ-ḍayqi wa-l-wusʿi
wa-zin wāridāti dh-dhikri bi-sh-sharʿi ḥākiyyan
li-shaykhika kulla mā atāka wa-sāriʿi
fa-salbu khtiyārin thumma kulli irādatin
huwa l-mawridu l-aṣfā fa-hal anta sāmiʿi
wa-hāka maqāmāti l-yaqīni fa-bādiran
bi-tawbatin zuhdin thumma khawfin bi-wāziʿi
rajāʾin wa-shukrin thumma ṣabrin tawakkulin
kadhāka r-riḍā wa-l-ḥubbu li-l-kulli jāmiʿi
wa-asbābuhu l-fikru ṣ-ṣafiyyu fī niʿmatin
wa-ḥusni ṣifātin thumma fi n-nūri l-lāmiʿi
wa-aʿnī bihi dhāka r-rasūla muḥammadan
ʿalayhi ṣalātun ʿadda watrin maʿa sh-shafʿi
wa-ālihi wa-l-aṣḥābi maʿ kulli ʿārifin
daʿā li-ṭarīqi llāhi fī kulli majmaʿi
Peace be upon the brothers in every place
a peace that embraces all in every assembly.
I wish to give good counsel to all, hoping
to obtain desire, might, the opening and strength.
My first counsel for those dedicated to Taqwa
is to accompany the best in attracting and repulsing.
For this is the basis of all good if you are intelligent;
so rely on it, along with being mindful of the Shariʿa.
All those who have obtained knowledge and mastery
have only obtained them by accompanying a humble man.
By him I mean the Shaykh whose light has overflowed,
and who has brought secrets and uninterrupted good with him.
If you desire lights and the opening of inner sight,
then copy him in exalting Allah and turn from people of conflict.
And persevere in the dhikr taught through Idhn
and neglect it neither in constriction nor expansion.
Weigh the luminous openings of the dhikr with the Shariʿa,
telling your Shaykh quickly all that happens to you.
So the negation of choice, and then all will,
is the purest of springs, if you are able to hear.
These are the Stations of Certainty – hasten to tawba,
doing-without, and then fear which brings restraint.
Hope, gratitude, then patience and putting your trust in Allah,
similarly contentment, and love unites them all.
Its causes are the pure contemplation of blessing and of
the perfection of the Attributes, then of the dazzling light.
By it, I mean that Messenger Muhammad,
may blessings be upon him in quantity as great as all that is even or odd,
and on his family and Companions and every gnostic,
calling to the path of Allah in every assembly.
